## Extracting negative-mode data from Compound Discoverer

```{r extracting-negative-mode-data-from-compound-discoverer-setup}
# ============================================================
# NEGATIVE MODE — Matrix effect correction workflow
# ============================================================

# ============================================================
# 1️⃣ Filter NEG chromatogram data
# ============================================================

filtered_data_neg2 <- long_data2 %>%
  filter(
    Sequence %in% 1:45,
    Compound %in% c(
      "Leucine-d10",
      "GlutamicAcid-d5",
      "StearicAcid-d35",
      "CholicAcid-d4",
      "Glucose-13C6",
      "Tryptophan-d5"
      
    ),
    Charge == -1,
    Wash %in% c("22x", "08x", "04x", "NoWash", "PPT"),
    !(Replicate %in% c("1", "2", "3", "4", "6") & Sample == "Solvent"),
    Replicate %in% 1:8
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Wash = factor(Wash, levels = c("22x", "08x", "04x", "NoWash", "PPT"))
  )

# ============================================================
# 2️⃣ Calculate matrix-effect data
# ============================================================

matrix_effect_data_neg <- filtered_data_neg2 %>%
  filter(Sample %in% c("NIST", "Solvent")) %>%
  group_by(Sequence, Wash, Scan, Compound, Sample, Replicate) %>%
  reframe(
    Average_value = mean(Intensities, na.rm = TRUE),
    Times = dplyr::first(Times)
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Sample,
    values_from = Average_value
  ) %>%
  group_by(Wash, Scan, Compound) %>%
  reframe(
    Solvent_mean = mean(Solvent, na.rm = TRUE),
    NIST_value = NIST[!is.na(NIST)],
    Times = dplyr::first(Times),
    Replicate = Replicate[!is.na(NIST)]
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Matrix_Effect = ((NIST_value / Solvent_mean) * 100) - 100,
    Matrix_Effect_Factor = 1 + (Matrix_Effect / 100)
  )

# ============================================================
# 3️⃣ Load supplementary feature data
# ============================================================

feat.intensity.threshold <- 1e4
signal.factor <- 3

Sup_info <- here("Data", "Supplementary Data.xlsx")

data4 <- read_excel(Sup_info, sheet = "Peak Areas")

data_meta <- read_excel(Sup_info, sheet = "Feature List") %>%
  mutate(
    Charge = case_when(
      Polarity == "POS" ~ 1,
      Polarity == "NEG" ~ -1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-Polarity)

data_feature_long <- data4 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("X"),
    names_to = "Feature",
    values_to = "Intensity"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    data_meta,
    by = c("Feature" = "id")
  ) %>%
  filter(Sequence %in% 1:45)

dup_features <- data_feature_long %>%
  group_by(Intensity) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(Feature) > 1) %>%
  arrange(Feature) %>%
  slice(-1) %>%
  pull(Feature)

data_feature_long <- data_feature_long %>%
  filter(!Feature %in% dup_features)

cat("Removed duplicated features:", length(dup_features), "\n")

nist_data <- data_feature_long %>%
  filter(Sample == "NIST")

exclude_compounds <- merged_df %>%
  filter(!homologue_id %in% c(3, 6)) %>%
  pull(`peak_id`)

# ============================================================
# 4️⃣ Compute RSD per wash for NEG features
# ============================================================

rsd_per_wash_neg <- nist_data %>%
  group_by(Wash, Feature) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = sum(!is.na(Intensity)),
    mean_val = mean(Intensity, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_val = sd(Intensity, na.rm = TRUE),
    RSD = (sd_val / mean_val) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Feature) %>%
  filter(all(mean_val > feat.intensity.threshold)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!Feature %in% exclude_compounds) %>%
  group_by(Feature) %>%
  mutate(
    ppt_mean = mean_val[Wash == "PPT"],
    other_mean = mean(mean_val[Wash != "PPT"], na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  filter(!(ppt_mean > other_mean * signal.factor)) %>%
  mutate(
    nowash_mean = mean_val[Wash == "NoWash"],
    other_mean2 = mean(mean_val[Wash != "NoWash"], na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  filter(!(nowash_mean > other_mean2 * signal.factor)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(
    nist_data %>%
      group_by(Feature) %>%
      summarise(
        global_mean = mean(Intensity, na.rm = TRUE),
        global_sd = sd(Intensity, na.rm = TRUE),
        global_RSD = (global_sd / global_mean) * 100,
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = "Feature"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    data_meta %>%
      select(id, Name, rt, mz, Adduct, Charge),
    by = c("Feature" = "id")
  ) %>%
  filter(Charge == -1)

# ============================================================
# 5️⃣ Helper functions for NEG matching
# ============================================================

ppm <- 5
rt_tol <- 0.1

count_files_for_compound_neg <- function(name, mz, rt) {
  
  ppm_tol <- mz * ppm / 1e6
  mz_lower <- mz - ppm_tol
  mz_upper <- mz + ppm_tol
  
  matches <- RT_interval %>%
    mutate(`RT [min]` = as.numeric(`RT [min]`)) %>%
    filter(
      between(`m/z`, mz_lower, mz_upper),
      between(`RT [min]`, rt - rt_tol, rt + rt_tol),
      Charge == -1
    ) %>%
    inner_join(
      file.list %>%
        distinct(`Study File ID`, .keep_all = TRUE),
      by = "Study File ID"
    ) %>%
    filter(Sample != "Blank") %>%
    group_by(`Study File ID`) %>%
    slice_min(abs(`RT [min]` - rt), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  n_distinct(matches$`Study File ID`)
}

build_Tryp_MEF_neg <- function(mz, rt) {
  
  ppm_tol <- mz * ppm / 1e6
  mz_lower <- mz - ppm_tol
  mz_upper <- mz + ppm_tol
  
  RT_interval %>%
    mutate(`RT [min]` = as.numeric(`RT [min]`)) %>%
    filter(
      between(`m/z`, mz_lower, mz_upper),
      between(`RT [min]`, rt - rt_tol, rt + rt_tol),
      Charge == -1
    ) %>%
    inner_join(
      file.list %>%
        distinct(`Study File ID`, .keep_all = TRUE),
      by = "Study File ID"
    ) %>%
    filter(Sample != "Blank") %>%
    group_by(`Study File ID`) %>%
    slice_min(abs(`RT [min]` - rt), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# ============================================================
# 6️⃣ Keep only NEG features found in all 15 files
# ============================================================

rsd_per_wash15_neg <- rsd_per_wash_neg %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    n_files = count_files_for_compound_neg(Name, mz, rt)
  ) %>%
  filter(n_files == 15) %>%
  ungroup()

# ============================================================
# 7️⃣ Auto-load or compute NEG correction results
# ============================================================

# Optional: uncomment this once if you need to force recalculation
# file.remove(here("Data", "all_result_neg2.rds"))

if (file.exists(here("Data", "all_result_neg.rds"))) {
  
  message("▶ Loading saved all_result_neg.rds...")
  all_result_neg <- readRDS(here("Data", "all_result_neg.rds"))
  
} else {
  
  message("▶ No saved NEG file found — running full NEG analysis...")
  
  all_result_neg <- rsd_per_wash15_neg %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    do({
      
      compound_name <- .$Name
      mz_target <- .$mz
      rt_target <- .$rt
      feature_id <- .$Feature
      
      message(
        "Processing NEG: ", compound_name,
        " (m/z=", mz_target, ", rt=", rt_target, ")"
      )
      
      Tryp_MEF <- build_Tryp_MEF_neg(mz_target, rt_target)
      
      result <- Tryp_MEF %>%
        full_join(matrix_effect_data_neg, by = c("Wash", "Replicate")) %>%
        filter(
          Times >= `Left RT [min]`,
          Times <= `Right RT [min]`
        ) %>%
        group_by(Wash, Replicate, Compound) %>%
        summarise(
          mean_rt = mean(Times, na.rm = TRUE),
          mean_MEF = mean(Matrix_Effect_Factor, na.rm = TRUE),
          median_MEF = median(Matrix_Effect_Factor, na.rm = TRUE),
          min_MEF = min(Matrix_Effect_Factor, na.rm = TRUE),
          Area = dplyr::first(Area),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          corrected_mean = Area / mean_MEF,
          corrected_median = Area / median_MEF,
          corrected_min = Area / min_MEF,
          Name = compound_name,
          Feature = feature_id
        )
      
      result
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  saveRDS(all_result_neg, here("Data", "all_result_neg.rds"))
  
  message("✔ Saved NEG results to all_result_neg.rds")
}

message("▶ all_result_neg is loaded and ready!")

# ============================================================
# 8️⃣ Convert NEG results to long format
# ============================================================

result_long_neg <- all_result_neg %>%
  distinct(
    Feature,
    Name,
    Wash,
    Replicate,
    Compound,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    uncorrected = Area
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      uncorrected,
      corrected_mean,
      corrected_median,
      corrected_min
    ),
    names_to = "Correction_Type",
    values_to = "Corrected_Value"
  )

# ============================================================
# 9️⃣ Quick checks
# ============================================================

result_long_neg %>%
  count(Correction_Type)

result_long_neg %>%
  count(Wash, Correction_Type)

result_long_neg %>%
  summarise(
    n_features = n_distinct(Feature),
    n_pcis = n_distinct(Compound),
    n_rows = n()
  )
```

## Validation in NEG

```{r validation-in-neg-setup}
  # ============================================================
  # Matrix Effect Correction Evaluation
  # Training vs Validation
  # Negative mode
  # All objects use _neg suffix to avoid interfering with POS
  # ============================================================
  
  set.seed(1)
  
  # ============================================================
  # 0. Prepare input table — NEG
  # ============================================================
  
  table_test_neg <- result_long_neg %>%
    select(Wash, Replicate, Feature, Compound, Correction_Type, Corrected_Value) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      Treatment      = Wash,
      PCI            = Compound,
      CorrectionType = Correction_Type,
      CorrectedArea  = Corrected_Value
    )
  
  df_neg <- table_test_neg %>%
    mutate(
      CorrectionType = factor(
        CorrectionType,
        levels = c(
          "uncorrected",
          "corrected_mean",
          "corrected_median",
          "corrected_min"
        )
      )
    )
  
  # ============================================================
  # 1. Random split: 1 validation replicate per treatment — NEG
  # ============================================================
  
  validation_ids_neg <- df_neg %>%
    distinct(Treatment, Replicate) %>%
    group_by(Treatment) %>%
    sample_n(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(Set = "Validation")
  
  split_df_neg <- df_neg %>%
    left_join(validation_ids_neg, by = c("Treatment", "Replicate")) %>%
    mutate(Set = if_else(is.na(Set), "Training", Set))
  
  train_df_neg <- split_df_neg %>%
    filter(Set == "Training", CorrectionType != "uncorrected")
  
  val_df_neg <- split_df_neg %>%
    filter(Set == "Validation") %>%
    mutate(
      PCI = if_else(
        CorrectionType == "uncorrected",
        "uncorrected",
        PCI
      )
    ) %>%
    distinct(
      Treatment, Replicate, Feature, PCI, CorrectionType,
      .keep_all = TRUE
    )
  
  uncorrected_df_neg <- split_df_neg %>%
    filter(CorrectionType == "uncorrected")
  
  # ============================================================
  # 2. Training uncorrected RSD — NEG
  # ============================================================
  
  train_uncorr_rsd_neg <- uncorrected_df_neg %>%
    filter(Set == "Training") %>%
    group_by(Feature) %>%
    summarise(
      train_rsd_uncorrected =
        100 * sd(CorrectedArea, na.rm = TRUE) /
        mean(CorrectedArea, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # ============================================================
  # 3. Training corrected RSDs — NEG
  # ============================================================
  
  rsd_train_all_neg <- train_df_neg %>%
    group_by(Feature, PCI, CorrectionType) %>%
    summarise(
      Best_train_RSD =
        100 * sd(CorrectedArea, na.rm = TRUE) /
        mean(CorrectedArea, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  correction_types_neg <- c(
    "corrected_mean",
    "corrected_median",
    "corrected_min"
  )
  
  # ============================================================
  # 4. Best PCI per feature for each correction type — NEG
  # ============================================================
  
  best_pci_per_correction_neg <- rsd_train_all_neg %>%
    filter(CorrectionType %in% correction_types_neg) %>%
    group_by(Feature, CorrectionType) %>%
    slice_min(Best_train_RSD, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      Best_PCI = PCI
    )
  
  # ============================================================
  # 5. Validation RSD for selected PCI per correction type — NEG
  # ============================================================
  
  rsd_val_by_correction_neg <- val_df_neg %>%
    inner_join(
      best_pci_per_correction_neg,
      by = c(
        "Feature",
        "PCI" = "Best_PCI",
        "CorrectionType"
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Best_PCI = PCI
    ) %>%
    group_by(
      Feature,
      CorrectionType,
      Best_PCI,
      Best_train_RSD
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      RSD_corrected =
        100 * sd(CorrectedArea, na.rm = TRUE) /
        mean(CorrectedArea, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
# ============================================================
# 6. Validation uncorrected RSD — NEG
# Pairwise Feature × PCI, then collapsed for feature-level summary
# ============================================================

uncorr_val_neg <- uncorrected_df_neg %>%
  filter(Set == "Validation") %>%
  semi_join(rsd_val_by_correction_neg, by = "Feature") %>%
  group_by(Feature, PCI) %>%
  summarise(
    RSD_val_uncorr =
      100 * sd(CorrectedArea, na.rm = TRUE) /
      mean(CorrectedArea, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Feature, PCI) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_RSD_val_uncorr = mean(RSD_val_uncorr, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

uncorr_val_feature_neg <- uncorr_val_neg %>%
  group_by(Feature) %>%
  summarise(
    RSD_uncorrected = median(Mean_RSD_val_uncorr, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ============================================================
# 7. Choose corrected vs uncorrected based on TRAINING RSD — NEG
# ============================================================

best_vs_uncorrected_neg <- uncorr_val_feature_neg %>%
  left_join(
    rsd_val_by_correction_neg,
    by = "Feature"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    train_uncorr_rsd_neg,
    by = "Feature"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Training_uncorrected_is_less =
      train_rsd_uncorrected <= Best_train_RSD,

    Chosen = if_else(
      Training_uncorrected_is_less,
      "uncorrected",
      as.character(CorrectionType)
    ),

    Chosen_PCI = if_else(
      Chosen == "uncorrected",
      NA_character_,
      as.character(Best_PCI)
    ),

    RSD_val = if_else(
      Chosen == "uncorrected",
      RSD_uncorrected,
      RSD_corrected
    ),

    Type = case_when(
      CorrectionType == "corrected_mean"   ~ "Best mean/uncorrected",
      CorrectionType == "corrected_median" ~ "Best median/uncorrected",
      CorrectionType == "corrected_min"    ~ "Best min/uncorrected",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Feature,
    Type,
    Chosen,
    Chosen_PCI,
    RSD_uncorrected,
    RSD_corrected,
    train_rsd_uncorrected,
    Best_train_RSD,
    Training_uncorrected_is_less,
    RSD_val
  )

# ============================================================
# 8. Best overall selected by TRAINING RSD — NEG
# ============================================================

best_overall_plot_neg <- best_vs_uncorrected_neg %>%
  mutate(
    train_rsd_selected = if_else(
      Chosen == "uncorrected",
      train_rsd_uncorrected,
      Best_train_RSD
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Feature) %>%
  slice_min(
    train_rsd_selected,
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Type = "Best overall"
  ) %>%
  select(
    Feature,
    Type,
    Chosen,
    Chosen_PCI,
    RSD_val,
    RSD_uncorrected,
    RSD_corrected,
    train_rsd_uncorrected,
    Best_train_RSD,
    Training_uncorrected_is_less
  )

# ============================================================
# 9. Uncorrected reference group — NEG
# ============================================================

uncorrected_plot_neg <- uncorr_val_feature_neg %>%
  left_join(
    train_uncorr_rsd_neg,
    by = "Feature"
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    Feature,
    Type = "Uncorrected",
    Chosen = "uncorrected",
    Chosen_PCI = NA_character_,
    RSD_val = RSD_uncorrected,
    RSD_uncorrected = RSD_uncorrected,
    RSD_corrected = NA_real_,
    train_rsd_uncorrected = train_rsd_uncorrected,
    Best_train_RSD = NA_real_,
    Training_uncorrected_is_less = NA
  )

# ============================================================
# 10. Final plot_df_neg for histogram and RSD-change plots
# ============================================================

plot_df_neg <- bind_rows(
  uncorrected_plot_neg,
  best_vs_uncorrected_neg,
  best_overall_plot_neg
) %>%
  mutate(
    Type = factor(
      Type,
      levels = c(
        "Uncorrected",
        "Best mean/uncorrected",
        "Best median/uncorrected",
        "Best min/uncorrected",
        "Best overall"
      )
    )
  )

# Quick checks
plot_df_neg %>%
  count(Type)

plot_df_neg %>%
  group_by(Type) %>%
  summarise(
    median_RSD = median(RSD_val, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_features = n_distinct(Feature),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Plotting negative-mode summary

```{r plotting-negative-mode-summary-setup}
# ============================================================
# Publication-ready summary table — NEG
# ============================================================

RSD_CUTOFF <- 5

correction_summary_table_neg <- function(selected_type) {

  paired_rsd_neg <- plot_df_neg %>%
    filter(Type == selected_type) %>%
    select(Feature, RSD_uncorrected, RSD_val) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    filter(!is.na(RSD_uncorrected), !is.na(RSD_val)) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      Uncorrected = RSD_uncorrected,
      Corrected   = RSD_val
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Delta_RSD = Uncorrected - Corrected,
      Category = case_when(
        Delta_RSD >=  RSD_CUTOFF ~ "Improved",
        Delta_RSD <= -RSD_CUTOFF ~ "Worsened",
        TRUE                     ~ "Less affected"
      )
    )

  diff_values_neg <- paired_rsd_neg$Uncorrected - paired_rsd_neg$Corrected

  if (length(diff_values_neg) >= 3) {
    shapiro_res_neg <- shapiro.test(diff_values_neg)
    shapiro_p_neg <- shapiro_res_neg$p.value
  } else {
    shapiro_p_neg <- NA_real_
  }

  if (!is.na(shapiro_p_neg) && shapiro_p_neg > 0.05) {

    test_res_neg <- t.test(
      paired_rsd_neg$Uncorrected,
      paired_rsd_neg$Corrected,
      paired = TRUE,
      alternative = "greater"
    )

  } else {

    test_res_neg <- wilcox.test(
      paired_rsd_neg$Uncorrected,
      paired_rsd_neg$Corrected,
      paired = TRUE,
      alternative = "greater",
      exact = FALSE
    )
  }

  tibble(
    Correction = selected_type,

    `Median RSD before (%)` =
      median(paired_rsd_neg$Uncorrected, na.rm = TRUE),

    `Median RSD after (%)` =
      median(paired_rsd_neg$Corrected, na.rm = TRUE),

    `Shapiro p-value` = shapiro_p_neg,

    `p-value` = test_res_neg$p.value,

    `Improved (n)` =
      sum(paired_rsd_neg$Category == "Improved", na.rm = TRUE),

    `Worsened (n)` =
      sum(paired_rsd_neg$Category == "Worsened", na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

correction_summary_neg <- bind_rows(
  correction_summary_table_neg("Best mean/uncorrected"),
  correction_summary_table_neg("Best median/uncorrected"),
  correction_summary_table_neg("Best min/uncorrected"),
  correction_summary_table_neg("Best overall")
) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        `Median RSD before (%)`,
        `Median RSD after (%)`
      ),
      ~ round(.x, 1)
    ),
    `Shapiro p-value` = format.pval(
      `Shapiro p-value`,
      digits = 2,
      eps = 0.001
    ),
    `p-value` = format.pval(
      `p-value`,
      digits = 2,
      eps = 0.001
    ),
    Correction = c(
      "Mean",
      "Median",
      "Minimum",
      "Best overall"
    )
  )

correction_summary_neg
```

## Plotting negative-mode histogram

```{r plotting-negative-mode-histogram-setup}
######## Histogram + RT Chromatogram Improvement Plot
######## Best mean correction from plot_df_neg

RSD_CUTOFF <- 5

# ============================================================
# 1️⃣ Prep data for histogram
# ============================================================

plot_rsd_hist_neg <- plot_df_neg %>%
  filter(Type == "Best mean/uncorrected") %>%
  select(Feature, RSD_uncorrected, RSD_val) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    Uncorrected = RSD_uncorrected,
    Corrected   = RSD_val
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Uncorrected, Corrected),
    names_to = "Group",
    values_to = "RSD"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(RSD))

# Compute medians for median lines
median_rsd_neg <- plot_rsd_hist_neg %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(Median_RSD = median(RSD, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = Median_RSD)

# ============================================================
# 2️⃣ Normality check paired differences
# ============================================================

paired_rsd_neg <- plot_df_neg %>%
  #filter(Type == "Best mean/uncorrected") %>%
  select(Feature, Type, RSD_uncorrected, RSD_val) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(!is.na(RSD_uncorrected), !is.na(RSD_val))

diff_values_neg <- paired_rsd_neg$RSD_uncorrected - paired_rsd_neg$RSD_val

if (length(diff_values_neg) >= 3 &&
    shapiro.test(diff_values_neg)$p.value > 0.05) {
  
  test_res_neg <- t.test(
    paired_rsd_neg$RSD_uncorrected,
    paired_rsd_neg$RSD_val,
    paired = TRUE,
    alternative = "greater"
  )
  
  test_type_neg <- "Paired t-test"
  
} else {
  
  test_res_neg <- wilcox.test(
    paired_rsd_neg$RSD_uncorrected,
    paired_rsd_neg$RSD_val,
    paired = TRUE,
    alternative = "greater",
    exact = FALSE
  )
  
  test_type_neg <- "p-value"
}

pval_text_neg <- paste0(
  test_type_neg,
  " = ",
  formatC(test_res_neg$p.value, format = "e", digits = 1)
)

# ============================================================
# 3️⃣ Histogram Panel A
# ============================================================

val_histo_neg <- ggplot(plot_rsd_hist_neg, aes(x = RSD, fill = Group)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 30,
    position = "identity",
    alpha = 0.5,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = median_rsd_neg$Uncorrected,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "#e31a1c",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = median_rsd_neg$Corrected,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "#1f78b4",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
 annotate(
  "text",
  x = Inf,
  y = Inf,
  hjust = 1.0,
  vjust = 1.5,
  label = paste0(
    "Median uncorrected RSD = ",
    sprintf("%.1f", median_rsd_neg$Uncorrected),
    "%"
  ),
  color = "#e31a1c",
  size = 4,
  fontface = "bold"
) +
annotate(
  "text",
  x = Inf,
  y = Inf,
  hjust = 1.0,
  vjust = 3.0,
  label = paste0(
    "Median corrected RSD = ",
    sprintf("%.1f", median_rsd_neg$Corrected),
    "%"
  ),
  color = "#1f78b4",
  size = 4,
  fontface = "bold"
) +
annotate(
  "text",
  x = Inf,
  y = Inf,
  hjust = 1.0,
  vjust = 4.5,
  label = pval_text_neg,
  size = 4,
  fontface = "bold"
) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Uncorrected" = "#e31a1c",
      "Corrected"   = "#1f78b4"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, max(plot_rsd_hist_neg$RSD, na.rm = TRUE), by = 20),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "RSD (%)",
    y = "Number of Features",
    fill = NULL
  )

# ============================================================
# 4️⃣ Compute RT + ΔRSD for chromatogram plot
# ============================================================

rsd_delta_rt_neg <- plot_df_neg %>%
  filter(Type == "Best mean/uncorrected") %>%
  select(Feature, Type, RSD_uncorrected, RSD_val) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    Uncorrected = RSD_uncorrected,
    Corrected   = RSD_val
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Delta_RSD = Uncorrected - Corrected
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    result_long_neg %>%
      select(Feature, mean_rt) %>%
      group_by(Feature) %>%
      summarise(RT_min = mean(mean_rt, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"),
    by = "Feature"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    data_feature_long %>%
      select(Feature, Adduct, mz) %>%
      distinct(),
    by = "Feature"
  )

# ============================================================
# 5️⃣ User-defined cutoff
# ============================================================

rsd_delta_rt_neg <- rsd_delta_rt_neg %>%
  mutate(
    Category = case_when(
      Delta_RSD >=  RSD_CUTOFF ~ "Improved",
      Delta_RSD <= -RSD_CUTOFF ~ "Worsened",
      TRUE                     ~ "Less affected"
    )
  )

n_improved_neg <- sum(rsd_delta_rt_neg$Category == "Improved", na.rm = TRUE)
n_worsened_neg <- sum(rsd_delta_rt_neg$Category == "Worsened", na.rm = TRUE)

label_improved_neg <- paste0("RSD ≥ ", RSD_CUTOFF, "%  (n = ", n_improved_neg, ")")
label_worsened_neg <- paste0("RSD ≤ -", RSD_CUTOFF, "%  (n = ", n_worsened_neg, ")")

# ============================================================
# 6️⃣ RT chromatogram improvement plot Panel B
# ============================================================

min_rt_neg <- floor(min(rsd_delta_rt_neg$RT_min, na.rm = TRUE))
max_rt_neg <- max(
  14.5,
  ceiling(max(rsd_delta_rt_neg$RT_min, na.rm = TRUE))
)

rt_plot_neg <- ggplot(rsd_delta_rt_neg, aes(x = RT_min, y = Delta_RSD)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = RSD_CUTOFF, size = 1, linetype = "dotted", color = "#1f78b4") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -RSD_CUTOFF, size = 1, linetype = "dotted", color = "#e31a1c") +
  geom_point(aes(color = Category), size = 2, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Improved" = "#1f78b4",
      "Worsened" = "#e31a1c",
      "Less affected" = "grey50"
    )
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf,
    y = RSD_CUTOFF + 2,
    label = label_improved_neg,
    hjust = 1.1,
    vjust = 0,
    size = 4,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "#1f78b4"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf,
    y = -RSD_CUTOFF - 2,
    label = label_worsened_neg,
    hjust = 1.1,
    vjust = 1,
    size = 4,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "#e31a1c"
  ) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0.5, xmax = 1.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = NA, color = "grey40", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 4.0, xmax = 5.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = NA, color = "grey40", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 6.0, xmax = 7.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = NA, color = "grey40", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = Inf, label = "1",
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 5,
           color = "grey40", fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("text", x = 5.5, y = Inf, label = "2",
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 5,
           color = "grey40", fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("text", x = 7.5, y = Inf, label = "3",
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 5,
           color = "grey40", fontface = "bold") +
  scale_x_continuous(
  limits = c(min_rt_neg, max_rt_neg),
  breaks = seq(min_rt_neg, max_rt_neg, by = 2),
  expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))
) +
  labs(
    x = "Retention Time (min)",
     y = "RSD improvement (%)",
    color = "Outcome")

# ============================================================
# 7️⃣ Unified theme
# ============================================================

aligned_theme_neg <- theme_pubr(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13, margin = margin(t = 8)),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),   # remove y-axis title
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.position = "none"          # remove legend
  )

val_histo_neg <- val_histo_neg + aligned_theme_neg

rt_plot_neg <- rt_plot_neg + aligned_theme_neg 

# ============================================================
# 8️⃣ Combine histogram + chromatogram plot
# ============================================================

combined_plot_neg <- val_histo_neg / rt_plot_neg
combined_plot_neg

# ============================================================
# 9️⃣ Region counts for improved and worsened features
# ============================================================

region_counts_neg <- tibble(
  Region = c("0.5–1.5 min", "4.0–5.5 min", "6.0–7.5 min"),
  
  Count_Improved = c(
    rsd_delta_rt_neg %>%
      filter(RT_min >= 0.5, RT_min < 1.5, Category == "Improved") %>%
      nrow(),
    
    rsd_delta_rt_neg %>%
      filter(RT_min >= 4.0, RT_min < 5.5, Category == "Improved") %>%
      nrow(),
    
    rsd_delta_rt_neg %>%
      filter(RT_min >= 6.0, RT_min < 7.5, Category == "Improved") %>%
      nrow()
  ),
  
  Count_Worsened = c(
    rsd_delta_rt_neg %>%
      filter(RT_min >= 0.5, RT_min < 1.5, Category == "Worsened") %>%
      nrow(),
    
    rsd_delta_rt_neg %>%
      filter(RT_min >= 4.0, RT_min < 5.5, Category == "Worsened") %>%
      nrow(),
    
    rsd_delta_rt_neg %>%
      filter(RT_min >= 6.0, RT_min < 7.5, Category == "Worsened") %>%

)
```

## Figure SI-1. Flowrate

### Data extraction

```{r figure-si-1-data-extraction}
# -------------------------------
# File names (defined once)
# -------------------------------
PCI_data <- "Skyline-Exp04-KU-IS-PAN-PCI.tsv"
Pump_pressure_data <- "240815-PAN-001-Blank-1uM-05ulmin-pump pressure.csv"

# -------------------------------
# Load PCI chromatogram data
# -------------------------------
# Reads Skyline export containing chromatogram intensities and times
data <- read_tsv(
  here("Data", PCI_data)
)

# -------------------------------
# Load pump pressure data
# -------------------------------
# Reads pump pressure log; skip header metadata rows
Pressure_data <- read_csv(
  here("Data", Pump_pressure_data),
  skip = 3
)

# -------------------------------
# Prepare PCI data for analysis
# -------------------------------
# - Rename columns for clarity
# - Parse chromatogram metadata from filenames
# - Filter invalid / shutdown runs
# - Calculate normalized and offset intensities
data1 <- data %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    Chromatograms = FileName,
    Compound = PeptideModifiedSequence,
    Adduct = PrecursorCharge,
    Charge = ProductCharge
  ) %>%
  select(-IsotopeLabelType, -TotalArea, -FragmentIon) %>%
   mutate(
    Chromatograms = str_replace(Chromatograms, "Without", "0uM"),
    Chromatograms = str_replace(Chromatograms, "PCI", "00ulmin")) %>%
  separate(
    Chromatograms,
    into = c(
      "Date",
      "PAN",
      "Sequence_Number",
      "Sample",
      "Concentration",
      "Flow_Rate"
    ),
    sep = "-",
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  mutate(    
    Sequence_Number = str_extract(Sequence_Number, "\\d+"),
    Concentration = str_extract(Concentration, "\\d+uM"),
    Flow_Rate = as.numeric(str_extract(Flow_Rate, "\\d+"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!str_detect(Chromatograms, regex("shutdown", ignore_case = TRUE))) #%>%
  #filter(Compound %in% c("Phenylalanine-d8-POS", "Phenylalanine-d8-NEG"))

data_intensity <- data1 %>%
  select(Chromatograms, Compound, Intensities) %>%
  separate_wider_delim(Intensities,
                       delim = ";",
                      names_sep = "",
                      too_few = "align_start") %>%
  mutate(across(3:ncol(.), ~ as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", .))))  
  
data_time <- data1 %>%
  select(Chromatograms,Compound, Times) %>%
  separate_wider_delim(Times,
                       delim = ";",
                       names_sep = "",
                       too_few = "align_start") %>%
  mutate(across(3:ncol(.), ~ as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", .))))  

combined_data <- data1 %>%
  select(-Intensities,-Times) %>%
  right_join(data_time, by = c("Chromatograms","Compound")) %>%
  right_join(data_intensity, by = c("Chromatograms","Compound"))

long_data_flow <- combined_data %>%
    pivot_longer(
    cols = c(starts_with("Times"), starts_with("Intensities")),
    names_to = c(".value", "pair"),
    names_pattern = "(Times|Intensities)(\\d+)")

Pressure_data <- Pressure_data %>%
  dplyr::rename( "Time" = "Time(min)", "Pressure" = "ElutingPump_Pressure bar")

```

### Plot: Effect of PCI programmed flow rates

```{r figure-si-1-plot-effect-of-pci-programmed-flow-rates}
# ---- Data preparation ----
small_data <- long_data_flow %>%
  filter(Times >= 0, Times <= 20,
         Concentration == "5uM",
         Charge == 1,
         Compound == "Leucine d-10-POS",
         Sequence_Number != "000") %>%
  group_by(Flow_Rate) %>%
  mutate(
    Average = rollmean(Intensities, k = 9, fill = "extend", align = "left"),
    Normalized_Average = (Average - min(Average, na.rm = TRUE)) / 
                         (max(Average, na.rm = TRUE) - min(Average, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(Flow_Rate)) %>%
  mutate(
    Flow_Rate_Label = factor(paste0(Flow_Rate, " µL/min"), 
                             levels = paste0(sort(unique(Flow_Rate), decreasing = TRUE), " µL/min")),
    Flow_Rate_Rank = dense_rank(Flow_Rate),
    Offset = 0.1 * (Flow_Rate_Rank - 1),
    Offset_Average = Normalized_Average + Offset
  ) %>%
  filter(between(Times, 0, 6))

# Pressure transformation
intensity_range <- range(small_data$Offset_Average, na.rm = TRUE)

Pressure_data_filtered <- Pressure_data %>%
  filter(Time >= min(small_data$Times), Time <= max(small_data$Times)) %>%
  mutate(Scaled_Pressure = rescale(Pressure, to = intensity_range))

pressure_range <- range(Pressure_data$Pressure, na.rm = TRUE)
a <- diff(intensity_range) / diff(pressure_range)
b <- intensity_range[1] - a * pressure_range[1]
inv_rescale <- function(x) (x - b) / a

# Labeling for legend
small_data$Legend_Label <- small_data$Flow_Rate_Label
Pressure_data_filtered$Legend_Label <- "Pressure Curve"

# Color palette (Dark2 or Okabe–Ito)
n_colors <- length(unique(small_data$Flow_Rate_Label))
chromatogram_colors <- brewer.pal(min(n_colors, 8), "Dark2")

# ---- Create label data near the start of each curve ----
label_data <- small_data %>%
  filter(Times >= 2, Times <= 2.5) %>%
  group_by(Flow_Rate_Label) %>%
  slice_min(Times, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(Flow_Rate_Label != "Pressure Curve") %>%  # Remove Pressure Curve
  mutate(Offset_Label = Offset_Average + 0.02)     # Raise label above curve

# ---- Plot construction with above-curve labels ----
Figure_SI.1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = small_data, aes(x = Times, y = Offset_Average, 
                                   color = Flow_Rate_Label,
                                   group = Flow_Rate_Label), size = 0.8) +
  geom_line(data = Pressure_data_filtered, aes(x = Time, y = Scaled_Pressure), 
            linetype = "longdash", color = "black", size = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 3.8, linetype = "dotted", color = "black", size = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 4.95, linetype = "dotted", color = "black", size = 1) +
  geom_text(
    data = label_data,
    aes(x = Times + 0.1, y = Offset_Label + 0.01, label = Flow_Rate_Label, color = Flow_Rate_Label),
    vjust = 0, size = 4.5, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  annotate("text",
           x = 3.8,
           y = max(small_data$Offset_Average, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.03,
           label = "25% B",
           size = 4.2,
           hjust = -0.1,
           vjust = -0.6) +
  annotate("text",
           x = 4.95,
           y = max(small_data$Offset_Average, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.03,
           label = "51% B",
           size = 4.2,
           hjust = -0.1,
           vjust = -0.6) +
  annotate("text",
           x = 4.4,
           y = max(Pressure_data_filtered$Scaled_Pressure, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.00,
           label = "Pressure Curve",
           color = "black",
           size = 4.5,
           hjust = 0.5) +
  labs(
    x = "Time (min)",
    y = "Normalized Intensity with Offset"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ inv_rescale(.), name = "Pressure (bar)")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = setNames(chromatogram_colors, unique(small_data$Flow_Rate_Label))
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# ---- Render Plot ----
print(Figure_SI.1)
```

## Figure SI-2. Effect of PLR

### Data: faster to extract TIC using mzR

```{r figure-si-2-data-faster-to-extract-tic-using-mzr}
# Set working directory

# List all mzML files in the folder
mzml_files <- list.files(path = mzml_folder, pattern = "*.mzML", full.names = TRUE)

extract_tic <- function(file_path) {
  # Open mzML file
  raw_data <- openMSfile(file_path)
  
  # Extract scan metadata
  header_info <- header(raw_data)
  
  # Extract TIC data
  tic_data <- data.frame(
    rt = header_info$retentionTime / 60,  # Convert RT to minutes
    intensity = header_info$totIonCurrent,
    polarity = header_info$polarity,
    filename = basename(file_path)  # Extract file name
  )
  
  return(tic_data)
}

# Extract TIC for all files
tic_list <- lapply(mzml_files, extract_tic)

tic_df_all <- bind_rows(tic_list)

# Process TIC Data
tic_df <- tic_df_all %>%
  # Remove file extension & split filename into metadata
  mutate(filename = str_remove(filename, "\\.mzML$")) %>%
  separate(filename, 
           into = c("Date", "Exp", "PAN", "Batch", "Sequence", "Wash", "Sample", "Dilution"), 
           sep = "-", 
           remove = FALSE,
           convert = TRUE) %>%
  # Keep metadata columns at the beginning
  select(filename, Date, Exp, PAN, Batch, Sequence, Wash, Sample, Dilution, everything()) %>%
  
  # Convert polarity to readable format
  mutate(polarity = ifelse(polarity == 1, "POS", "NEG")) %>%
  
  # Assign Scan numbers per filename & polarity
  group_by(filename, polarity) %>%
  mutate(Scan = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  # Sort and assign replicate numbers based on Wash & Sample
  arrange(Wash, Sample, Sequence) %>%
  group_by(Wash, Sample) %>%
  mutate(Replicate = dense_rank(Sequence)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Sample = ifelse(Wash == "NoFilter" & Sample == "Blank", "Reference", Sample))

tic_df <- tic_df %>%
  bind_rows(
    tic_df %>%
      filter(Sample == "Reference") %>%
      select(-Wash) %>%
      crossing(Wash = unique(tic_df$Wash[tic_df$Wash != "NoFilter"]))
  ) %>%
  filter(Wash != "NoFilter") %>%
  filter(Wash %in% c("22x", "08x", "04x", "NoWash", "PPT")) %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = case_when(
      Sample == "Reference" ~ "Solvent",
      Sample == "Blank" ~ "Process",
      TRUE ~ Sample
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(filename, polarity, Wash, Sample, Replicate) %>%
  arrange(Scan, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    Average = zoo::rollmean(intensity, k = 5, fill = NA, align = "left")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(between(rt, 0, 15))
```

```{r figure-si-2-plot}
# -----------------------------

tic_plot_df <- tic_df %>%

    Replicate == 3,
    polarity == "POS"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Average_offset = Average + offsets[Wash],
    label = wash_labels[Wash]
  ) %>%
  bind_rows(
    tic_df %>%
      filter(
        Sample == "Solvent",
        Wash == "22x",
        Replicate == 3,
        polarity == "POS"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Wash = "Solvent blank",
        Average_offset = Average + offsets["Solvent blank"],
        label = wash_labels["Solvent blank"]
      )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Wash = factor(
      Wash,
      levels = c("Solvent blank", "22x", "NoWash", "PPT")
    )
  )

# -----------------------------
# Data for line labels
# -----------------------------
label_df <- tic_plot_df %>%
  group_by(Wash) %>%
  slice_max(rt, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# -----------------------------
# Create plot
# -----------------------------
Figure_SI.2 <- tic_plot_df %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = rt,
      y = Average_offset,
      group = Wash,
      color = Wash
    )
  ) +

  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = 7.5, xmax = 14,
    ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
    fill = "gray80", alpha = 0.5
  ) +

  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = 5, xmax = 7,
    ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
    fill = "gray90", alpha = 0.5
  ) +

  geom_line(size = 0.9) +

  geom_text(
    data = label_df,
    aes(
      x = 1.2,
      y = Average_offset,
      label = label
    ),
    hjust = 0.0,
    vjust = 2.5,
    size = 4.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 10.75,
    y = max_intensity * 1.4,
    label = "Phospholipids",
    size = 4,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +

  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 6,
    y = max_intensity * 1.4,
    label = "Filter Contaminants",
    size = 4,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Retention Time (min)",
    y = "Total Ion Current"
  ) +

  scale_color_brewer(
    palette = "Dark2"
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0, max_intensity * 1.5)
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")
  )

print(Figure_SI.2)
```

```{r figure-si-3-plot-1}
# ---- Plot 1: ----

# identify peaks ~1 m/z apart using simple local maxima logic
annotated_peaks <- scan787_data %>%
  mutate(diff = c(NA, diff(mz))) %>%
  filter(
    intensity == max(intensity, na.rm = TRUE) |  
    (lag(intensity, 1, default = 0) < intensity &
     lead(intensity, 1, default = 0) < intensity)
  ) %>%
  filter(!duplicated(round(mz))) %>%   # avoid dense peaks
  arrange(mz)                          # ensure sorted m/z for spacing below

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Compute Δm/z, mean, SD
# ------------------------------------------------------------

peak_spacing <- annotated_peaks %>%
  mutate(delta_mz = mz - lag(mz)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(delta_mz))   # remove first NA

avg_delta <- mean(peak_spacing$delta_mz)
sd_delta  <- sd(peak_spacing$delta_mz)

cat("Average mass spacing (Δm/z):", avg_delta, "\n")
cat("Standard deviation:", sd_delta, "\n\n")

peak_spacing
```

### Nowash Glucose extract MS:

```{r figure-si-5-nowash-glucose-extract-ms}
# ============================================================
# Extract Nowash dilution mass spectra using xcmsRaw/raw scan index
# Positive scans only
# Glucose-13C6 target m/z = 204.1173
# ============================================================

# -----------------------------
# Settings
# -----------------------------
target_masses <- c(204.1173)
target_mz <- 204.1173
mz_range <- c(203.9, 204.2)

vline_positions <- c(0.78, 2.2)   # RT in minutes
rt_targets <- vline_positions
scan_labels <- paste("RT", rt_targets)

raw_folder <- "C:/Users/DanielMalheiro/Downloads/Exp7-Gradient and Dilution/mzML-PAN"

raw_cache_file <- here("Data", "combined_mass_spectra_241009_Nowash_Glucose_13C6_raw.rds")
processed_file <- here("Data", "glucose_nowash_spectra_processed.rds")

# -----------------------------
# Find Nowash dilution files
# -----------------------------
nowash_files <- list.files(
  raw_folder,
  pattern = "241009.*Nowash.*\\.(mzML|mzXML|raw)$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

nowash_files

# ============================================================
# Helper: identify positive scans
# ============================================================

get_positive_scans <- function(raw_data) {
  
  polarity <- raw_data@polarity
  
  positive_scans <- which(
    polarity == 1 |
      polarity == "+" |
      tolower(as.character(polarity)) %in% c("positive", "pos", "+")
  )
  
  if (length(positive_scans) == 0) {
    stop("No positive scans found in this file. Check raw_data@polarity.")
  }
  
  return(positive_scans)
}

# ============================================================
# Function to extract mass spectrum for a specific scan
# ============================================================

extract_mass_spectrum_for_scan <- function(scan_index, raw_data, mz_range) {
  
  scan_start <- raw_data@scanindex[scan_index] + 1
  
  scan_end <- ifelse(
    scan_index + 1 <= length(raw_data@scanindex),
    raw_data@scanindex[scan_index + 1],
    length(raw_data@env$mz)
  )
  
  mz_values <- raw_data@env$mz[scan_start:scan_end]
  intensity_values <- raw_data@env$intensity[scan_start:scan_end]
  
  mass_spectrum_df <- data.frame(
    mz = mz_values,
    intensity = intensity_values
  ) %>%
    filter(mz >= mz_range[1] & mz <= mz_range[2])
  
  return(mass_spectrum_df)
}

# ============================================================
# Helper function for empty scans
# ============================================================

ensure_spectrum_not_empty <- function(df, scan_label, mz_range) {
  
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    message("No data in ", scan_label, " - inserting zero-intensity points.")
    
    df <- data.frame(
      mz = c(mz_range[1], mz_range[2]),
      intensity = c(0, 0),
      scan = scan_label
    )
  }
  
  return(df)
}

# ============================================================
# Extract spectra from one file
# Positive scans only
# ============================================================

extract_spectra_from_file <- function(file_path, rt_targets, scan_labels, mz_range) {
  
  raw_data <- xcmsRaw(file_path)
  
  positive_scans <- get_positive_scans(raw_data)
  positive_rt_min <- raw_data@scantime[positive_scans] / 60
  
  selected_scans <- purrr::map_int(rt_targets, function(rt_target) {
    positive_scans[which.min(abs(positive_rt_min - rt_target))]
  })
  
  rt_selected <- raw_data@scantime[selected_scans] / 60
  
  message("File: ", basename(file_path))
  print(
    data.frame(
      scan_label = scan_labels,
      scan_index = selected_scans,
      RT_min = rt_selected,
      polarity = raw_data@polarity[selected_scans]
    )
  )
  
  spectra <- purrr::map2_dfr(
    seq_along(selected_scans),
    selected_scans,
    function(i, scan_index) {
      
      scan_label <- scan_labels[i]
      
      extract_mass_spectrum_for_scan(scan_index, raw_data, mz_range) %>%
        mutate(
          scan = scan_label,
          rt_target = rt_targets[i],
          rt_actual = rt_selected[i],
          scan_index = scan_index,
          polarity = raw_data@polarity[scan_index]
        ) %>%
        ensure_spectrum_not_empty(scan_label, mz_range)
    }
  )
  
  spectra %>%
    mutate(file = basename(file_path))
}

# ============================================================
# Extract all Nowash dilution spectra, with caching
# Cache only raw extracted spectra
# ============================================================

if (file.exists(raw_cache_file)) {
  
  message("Loading cached raw spectra from: ", raw_cache_file)
  glucose_nowash_spectra <- readRDS(raw_cache_file)
  
} else {
  
  message("Cached raw spectra not found. Extracting spectra...")
  
  glucose_nowash_spectra <- purrr::map_dfr(
    nowash_files,
    extract_spectra_from_file,
    rt_targets = rt_targets,
    scan_labels = scan_labels,
    mz_range = mz_range
  )
  
  saveRDS(glucose_nowash_spectra, raw_cache_file)
  
  message("Saved raw extracted spectra to: ", raw_cache_file)
}

# ============================================================
# Add metadata from Gradient and Dilution filename
# ============================================================

glucose_nowash_spectra <- glucose_nowash_spectra %>%
  separate(
    file,
    into = c("Date", "Exp", "PAN", "Batch", "Sequence", "Wash", "Sample", "Dilution"),
    sep = "-",
    remove = FALSE,
    fill = "right"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = str_remove(Sample, "\\.raw|\\.mzML|\\.mzXML"),
    Dilution = str_remove(Dilution, "\\.raw|\\.mzML|\\.mzXML"),
    Wash = str_remove(Wash, "\\.raw|\\.mzML|\\.mzXML"),
    Dilution = recode(
      as.character(Dilution),
      "100" = "1.0 µl",
      "050" = "0.5 µl",
      "025" = "0.25 µl",
      "010" = "0.1 µl"
    ),
    Dilution = factor(Dilution, levels = c("1.0 µl", "0.5 µl", "0.25 µl", "0.1 µl"))
  )

# ============================================================
# Add replicate number
# ============================================================

replicate_table_glucose_nowash <- glucose_nowash_spectra %>%
  distinct(Wash, Sample, Dilution, file) %>%
  group_by(Wash, Sample, Dilution) %>%
  arrange(file) %>%
  mutate(Replicate = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

glucose_nowash_spectra <- glucose_nowash_spectra %>%
  left_join(
    replicate_table_glucose_nowash,
    by = c("Wash", "Sample", "Dilution", "file")
  )

# ============================================================
# Save processed spectra
# ============================================================

saveRDS(glucose_nowash_spectra, processed_file)

message("Saved processed spectra to: ", processed_file)

# ============================================================
# Plot replicate 2
# Add zero-intensity points only at plot boundaries if needed
# ============================================================

plot_xlim <- c(204.105, 204.13)

glucose_nowash_plot_data <- glucose_nowash_spectra %>%
  filter(
    Replicate == 2,
    mz >= plot_xlim[1],
    mz <= plot_xlim[2]
  ) %>%
  group_by(Dilution, scan, file) %>%
  group_modify(~{

    df <- arrange(.x, mz)

    # Add zero at left boundary if first point is inside plot
    if (nrow(df) > 0 && min(df$mz) > plot_xlim[1]) {
      left_point <- df[1, ]
      left_point$mz <- plot_xlim[1]
      left_point$intensity <- 0
      df <- bind_rows(left_point, df)
    }

    # Add zero at right boundary if last point is inside plot
    if (nrow(df) > 0 && max(df$mz) < plot_xlim[2]) {
      right_point <- df[nrow(df), ]
      right_point$mz <- plot_xlim[2]
      right_point$intensity <- 0
      df <- bind_rows(df, right_point)
    }

    df
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

MS_glucose_nowash_dilution <- glucose_nowash_plot_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mz, y = intensity)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, aes(color = scan)) +
  geom_vline(

    color = "black"
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = plot_xlim,
    ylim = c(0, 2.2e6)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "Mass-to-charge ratio",
    breaks = target_masses,
    labels = format(target_masses, digits = 7)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::scientific,
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 3)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = bquote(
      atop(
        "PLR unwashed plasma",
        "Glucose -"^{13} * "C"[6]
      )
    ),
    y = "Intensity"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      size = 14
```

### PPT leucine extract MS:

```{r figure-si-5-ppt-leucine-extract-ms}
# ============================================================
# Extract PPT dilution mass spectra using xcmsRaw/raw scan index
# Positive scans only
# Leucine-d10 target m/z = 142.1647
# ============================================================

# -----------------------------
# Settings
# -----------------------------
target_masses <- c(142.1647)
target_mz <- 142.1647
mz_range <- c(141.9, 142.2)

rt_targets <- c(0.79, 10.9)   # RT in minutes
scan_labels <- paste("RT", rt_targets)

raw_folder <- "C:/Users/DanielMalheiro/Downloads/Exp7-Gradient and Dilution/mzML-PAN"

raw_cache_file <- here("Data", "combined_mass_spectra_241009_PPT_Leucine_d10_raw.rds")
processed_file <- here("Data", "leucine_ppt_spectra_processed.rds")

# -----------------------------
# Find PPT dilution files
# -----------------------------
ppt_files <- list.files(
  raw_folder,
  pattern = "241009.*PPT.*\\.(mzML|mzXML|raw)$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

ppt_files

# ============================================================
# Helper: identify positive scans
# ============================================================

get_positive_scans <- function(raw_data) {
  
  polarity <- raw_data@polarity
  
  positive_scans <- which(
    polarity == 1 |
      polarity == "+" |
      tolower(as.character(polarity)) %in% c("positive", "pos", "+")
  )
  
  if (length(positive_scans) == 0) {
    stop("No positive scans found in this file. Check raw_data@polarity.")
  }
  
  return(positive_scans)
}

# ============================================================
# Function to extract mass spectrum for a specific scan
# ============================================================

extract_mass_spectrum_for_scan <- function(scan_index, raw_data, mz_range) {
  
  scan_start <- raw_data@scanindex[scan_index] + 1
  
  scan_end <- ifelse(
    scan_index + 1 <= length(raw_data@scanindex),
    raw_data@scanindex[scan_index + 1],
    length(raw_data@env$mz)
  )
  
  mz_values <- raw_data@env$mz[scan_start:scan_end]
  intensity_values <- raw_data@env$intensity[scan_start:scan_end]
  
  data.frame(
    mz = mz_values,
    intensity = intensity_values
  ) %>%
    filter(mz >= mz_range[1] & mz <= mz_range[2])
}

# ============================================================
# Helper function for empty scans
# ============================================================

ensure_spectrum_not_empty <- function(df, scan_label, mz_range) {
  
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    message("No data in ", scan_label, " - inserting zero-intensity points.")
    
    df <- data.frame(
      mz = c(mz_range[1], mz_range[2]),
      intensity = c(0, 0),
      scan = scan_label
    )
  }
  
  return(df)
}

# ============================================================
# Extract spectra from one file
# Positive scans only
# ============================================================

extract_spectra_from_file <- function(file_path, rt_targets, scan_labels, mz_range) {
  
  raw_data <- xcmsRaw(file_path)
  
  positive_scans <- get_positive_scans(raw_data)
  positive_rt_min <- raw_data@scantime[positive_scans] / 60
  
  selected_scans <- purrr::map_int(rt_targets, function(rt_target) {
    positive_scans[which.min(abs(positive_rt_min - rt_target))]
  })
  
  rt_selected <- raw_data@scantime[selected_scans] / 60
  
  message("File: ", basename(file_path))
  print(
    data.frame(
      scan_label = scan_labels,
      scan_index = selected_scans,
      RT_min = rt_selected,
      polarity = raw_data@polarity[selected_scans]
    )
  )
  
  spectra <- purrr::map2_dfr(
    seq_along(selected_scans),
    selected_scans,
    function(i, scan_index) {
      
      scan_label <- scan_labels[i]
      
      extract_mass_spectrum_for_scan(scan_index, raw_data, mz_range) %>%
        mutate(
          scan = scan_label,
          rt_target = rt_targets[i],
          rt_actual = rt_selected[i],
          scan_index = scan_index,
          polarity = raw_data@polarity[scan_index]
        ) %>%
        ensure_spectrum_not_empty(scan_label, mz_range)
    }
  )
  
  spectra %>%
    mutate(file = basename(file_path))
}

# ============================================================
# Extract all PPT dilution spectra, with caching
# Cache only raw extracted spectra
# ============================================================

if (file.exists(raw_cache_file)) {
  
  message("Loading cached raw spectra from: ", raw_cache_file)
  leucine_ppt_spectra <- readRDS(raw_cache_file)
  
} else {
  
  message("Cached raw spectra not found. Extracting spectra...")
  
  leucine_ppt_spectra <- purrr::map_dfr(
    ppt_files,
    extract_spectra_from_file,
    rt_targets = rt_targets,
    scan_labels = scan_labels,
    mz_range = mz_range
  )
  
  saveRDS(leucine_ppt_spectra, raw_cache_file)
  
  message("Saved raw extracted spectra to: ", raw_cache_file)
}

# ============================================================
# Add metadata from Gradient and Dilution filename
# ============================================================

leucine_ppt_spectra <- leucine_ppt_spectra %>%
  separate(
    file,
    into = c("Date", "Exp", "PAN", "Batch", "Sequence", "Wash", "Sample", "Dilution"),
    sep = "-",
    remove = FALSE,
    fill = "right"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = str_remove(Sample, "\\.raw|\\.mzML|\\.mzXML"),
    Dilution = str_remove(Dilution, "\\.raw|\\.mzML|\\.mzXML"),
    Wash = str_remove(Wash, "\\.raw|\\.mzML|\\.mzXML"),
    Dilution = recode(
      as.character(Dilution),
      "100" = "1.0 µl",
      "050" = "0.5 µl",
      "025" = "0.25 µl",
      "010" = "0.1 µl"
    ),
    Dilution = factor(Dilution, levels = c("1.0 µl", "0.5 µl", "0.25 µl", "0.1 µl"))
  )

# ============================================================
# Add replicate number
# ============================================================

replicate_table_leucine <- leucine_ppt_spectra %>%
  distinct(Wash, Sample, Dilution, file) %>%
  group_by(Wash, Sample, Dilution) %>%
  arrange(file) %>%
  mutate(Replicate = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

leucine_ppt_spectra <- leucine_ppt_spectra %>%
  left_join(
    replicate_table_leucine,
    by = c("Wash", "Sample", "Dilution", "file")
  )

# ============================================================
# Save processed spectra
# ============================================================

saveRDS(leucine_ppt_spectra, processed_file)

message("Saved processed spectra to: ", processed_file)

# ============================================================
# Plot replicate 2
# Add zero-intensity points only at plot boundaries if needed
# ============================================================

plot_xlim <- c(142.158, 142.17)

leucine_ppt_plot_data <- leucine_ppt_spectra %>%
  filter(
    Replicate == 2,
    mz >= plot_xlim[1],
    mz <= plot_xlim[2]
  ) %>%
  group_by(Dilution, scan, file) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    
    df <- arrange(.x, mz)
    
    # Add zero at left boundary if first point is inside plot
    if (nrow(df) > 0 && min(df$mz) > plot_xlim[1]) {
      left_point <- df[1, ]
      left_point$mz <- plot_xlim[1]
      left_point$intensity <- 0
      df <- bind_rows(left_point, df)
    }
    
    # Add zero at right boundary if last point is inside plot
    if (nrow(df) > 0 && max(df$mz) < plot_xlim[2]) {
      right_point <- df[nrow(df), ]
      right_point$mz <- plot_xlim[2]
      right_point$intensity <- 0
      df <- bind_rows(df, right_point)
    }
    
    df
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

MS_leucine_ppt_dilution <- leucine_ppt_plot_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mz, y = intensity)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, aes(color = scan)) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = target_masses,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  facet_grid(Dilution ~ scan, scales = "free_x") +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = plot_xlim,
    ylim = c(0, 2e7)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "Mass-to-charge ratio",
    breaks = target_masses,
    labels = format(target_masses, digits = 7)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::scientific,
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 3)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = bquote(atop("PPT treated", "Leucine-d"[10])),
    y = "Intensity"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1.0),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 10.5),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")
  )  +
  labs(tag = "B") +
  theme(
    plot.tag = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 14
    ),
    plot.tag.position = c(0.01, 0.99))

print(MS_leucine_ppt_dilution)
```

## Figure SI-10. Effect of PLR wash intensity on contaminant signals

```{r figure-si-10-setup}
#---------------------------------------------
# 1. Filter and recode wash labels
#---------------------------------------------
wash_subset <- summarized_data %>%
  filter(homologue_id %in% c(1,14,16,17,18,19),
         Sequence <= 45,
         Sample == "Blank",
         Wash %in% c("NoWash", "22x", "08x", "04x")) %>%
  mutate(
    Wash = recode(Wash,
                  "22x"    = "PLR 22x Wash",
                  "08x"    = "PLR 8x Wash",
                  "04x"    = "PLR 4x Wash",
                  "NoWash" = "PLR Unwashed"),
    Wash = factor(Wash,
                  levels = c("PLR Unwashed", "PLR 4x Wash",
                             "PLR 8x Wash", "PLR 22x Wash")),
    
    homologue_id = factor(
      homologue_id,
      levels = c(1, 14, 16, 17, 18, 19),
      labels = c(
        "Homologue id 1",
        "Homologue id 14",
        "Homologue id 16",
        "Homologue id 17",
        "Homologue id 18",
        "Homologue id 19"
      )
    )
  )

#---------------------------------------------
# 2. Create log-transformed column (safe)
#---------------------------------------------
wash_subset <- wash_subset %>%
  mutate(
    log_intensity = log10(pmax(Intensity, 1e-6))
  )

#---------------------------------------------
# 3. Pairwise testing (log scale)
#---------------------------------------------
stat_test_raw <- wash_subset %>%
  group_by(homologue_id) %>%
  pairwise_t_test(
    log_intensity ~ Wash,
    p.adjust.method = "BH"
  )

stat_sig <- stat_test_raw

#---------------------------------------------
# 4. Compute per-facet max (for brackets)
#---------------------------------------------
y_max <- wash_subset %>%
  group_by(homologue_id) %>%
  summarise(max_y = max(log_intensity, na.rm = TRUE))

stat_sig <- stat_sig %>%
  left_join(y_max, by = "homologue_id") %>%
  group_by(homologue_id) %>%
  mutate(
    bracket_index = row_number(),
    y.position = max_y + 0.12 + 0.10 * (bracket_index - 1)   # ⭐ tighter spacing
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

#---------------------------------------------
# 5. Boxplot (log values plotted directly)
#---------------------------------------------
box_sig_plot <- wash_subset %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Wash, y = log_intensity, fill = Wash)) +
  
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ homologue_id, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "PLR Unwashed" = "grey40",
    "PLR 4x Wash"  = "#e31a1c",
    "PLR 8x Wash"  = "#33a02c",
    "PLR 22x Wash" = "#1f78b4"
  )) +

  stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat_sig,
    label = "p.adj.signif",
    size = 3,
    tip.length = 0.01
  ) +

  # ⭐ Clean numeric log axis (1,2,3...)
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Log10 Summed Intensity",
    breaks = seq(
      floor(min(wash_subset$log_intensity, na.rm = TRUE)),
      ceiling(max(wash_subset$log_intensity, na.rm = TRUE)),
      by = 1
    ),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.10))   # ⭐ reduced empty space
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Wash Condition"
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    strip.text  = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

box_sig_plot
```

## Figure SI-12. EIC of Acetyl-Carnitine and Glucose-13C6

### Data and Plot:

```{r figure-si-12-data-and-plot}
# Load the mzML file
file_nowash <- file.path(
  mzml_folder,"241008-Exp-PAN-1-035-NoWash-NIST.mzML")

if (!exists("raw_data_glu")) {
  raw_data_glu <- xcmsRaw(file_nowash)
} else {
  message("'raw_data_glu' already exists in the environment.")
}

ppm <- 2

# Define function to extract EIC for a target m/z
extract_eic <- function(raw_data, target_mz, ppm, polarity_label = "positive") {
  mz_tol <- (ppm / 1e6) * target_mz
  mz_range <- c(target_mz - mz_tol, target_mz + mz_tol)

  positive_scans <- which(raw_data@polarity == polarity_label)  # 1 = positive

  eic <- rawEIC(raw_data, mzrange = mz_range)

  eic_df <- data.frame(
    rt = raw_data@scantime[positive_scans] / 60,  # Convert to minutes
    intensity = eic$intensity[positive_scans],
    scan = seq_along(positive_scans),
    target = paste0("m/z ", round(target_mz, 4))
  ) %>%
    mutate(average_intensity = rollmean(intensity, k = 5, fill = NA, align = "left"))

  return(eic_df)
}

# Create mapping from m/z to metabolite name
target_labels <- c(
  `204.1173` = "Glucose-13C6",
  `204.1230` = "Acetyl-carnitine"
)

target_labels_plot <- c(
  `204.1173` = "Glucose-{}^{13}*C[6]",
  `204.1230` = "Acetyl-carnitine"
)

eic_df_1 <- extract_eic(raw_data_glu, 204.1173, ppm) %>%
  mutate(
    target = target_labels["204.1173"],
    target_plot = target_labels_plot["204.1173"]
  )

eic_df_2 <- extract_eic(raw_data_glu, 204.1230, ppm) %>%
  mutate(
    target = target_labels["204.1230"],
    target_plot = target_labels_plot["204.1230"]
  )

combined_eic_df <- bind_rows(eic_df_1, eic_df_2)

combined_eic_df_scaled <- combined_eic_df %>%
  group_by(target, target_plot) %>%
  mutate(scaled_intensity = average_intensity / max(average_intensity, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

chromatogram_overlay_scaled <- combined_eic_df_scaled %>%
  filter(between(rt, 0, 5)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = rt, y = scaled_intensity, color = target_plot)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    x = "Retention Time (min)",
    y = "Normalized Intensity",
    color = "Compound"
  ) +
  scale_color_discrete(labels = scales::label_parse()) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    #legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    #axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

print(chromatogram_overlay_scaled)

# Save
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "Figure_SI-12.png"),
  plot = chromatogram_overlay_scaled,
  width = 20,
  height = 10,
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 1000
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "Figure_SI-12.tiff"),
  plot = chromatogram_overlay_scaled,
  width = 20,
  height = 10,
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 1000,
  device = "tiff",
  compression = "lzw"
)
```

## Figure SI-13. Improved and worsened features

```{r figure-si-13-setup}
# ============================================================
# Arrow plots
# Mean correction from plot_df and plot_df_neg
# Faceted by polarity and correction effect
# Positive first, then negative
# ============================================================

RSD_CUTOFF <- 5

# ============================================================
# 1️⃣ Combine POS and NEG data
# ============================================================

plot_df_combined <- bind_rows(
  plot_df %>%
    mutate(Polarity = "Positive"),

  plot_df_neg %>%
    mutate(Polarity = "Negative")
)

result_long_combined <- bind_rows(
  result_long %>%
    mutate(Polarity = "Positive"),

  result_long_neg %>%
    mutate(Polarity = "Negative")
)

# ============================================================
# 2️⃣ Prepare data for arrow plot
# ============================================================

rsd_rt_arrow_combined <- plot_df_combined %>%
  filter(Type == "Best mean/uncorrected") %>%
  select(Polarity, Feature, RSD_uncorrected, RSD_val) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    Uncorrected = RSD_uncorrected,
    Corrected   = RSD_val
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Delta_RSD = Corrected - Uncorrected,
    Change_Class = case_when(
      Delta_RSD <= -RSD_CUTOFF ~ "Improved",
      Delta_RSD >=  RSD_CUTOFF ~ "Worsened",
      TRUE                     ~ "Less affected"
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    result_long_combined %>%
      group_by(Polarity, Feature) %>%
      summarise(
        RT_min = mean(mean_rt, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c("Polarity", "Feature")
  ) %>%
  filter(Change_Class %in% c("Improved", "Worsened")) %>%
  mutate(
    Polarity = factor(
      Polarity,
      levels = c("Positive", "Negative")
    ),
    Change_Class = factor(
      Change_Class,
      levels = c("Improved", "Worsened")
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 3️⃣ Calculate group means for dashed lines
# ============================================================

mean_lines <- rsd_rt_arrow_combined %>%
  group_by(Polarity, Change_Class) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Uncorrected = mean(Uncorrected, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Corrected   = mean(Corrected, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Polarity = factor(
      Polarity,
      levels = c("Positive", "Negative")
    ),
    Change_Class = factor(
      Change_Class,
      levels = c("Improved", "Worsened")
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 4️⃣ RT axis limits
# ============================================================

min_rt <- floor(min(rsd_rt_arrow_combined$RT_min, na.rm = TRUE))
max_rt <- 14

rt_x_scale <- scale_x_continuous(
  limits = c(min_rt, max_rt),
  breaks = seq(min_rt, max_rt, by = 2),
  expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))
)

# ============================================================
# 5️⃣ Shared theme
# ============================================================

aligned_theme <- theme_pubr(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16)
  )

# ============================================================
# 6️⃣ Faceted arrow plot
# ============================================================

plot_all <- ggplot(rsd_rt_arrow_combined) +

  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = RT_min,
      xend = RT_min,
      y = Uncorrected,
      yend = Corrected
    ),
    color = "grey40",
    linewidth = 1,
    alpha = 0.9,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.3, "cm"), type = "closed")
  ) +

  geom_point(
    aes(
      x = RT_min,
      y = Uncorrected,
      color = "Uncorrected"
    ),
    size = 2
  ) +

  geom_point(
    aes(
      x = RT_min,
      y = Corrected,
      color = "Corrected"
    ),
    size = 2
  ) +

  geom_hline(
    data = mean_lines,
    aes(yintercept = Mean_Uncorrected),
    color = "#e31a1c",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  geom_hline(
    data = mean_lines,
    aes(yintercept = Mean_Corrected),
    color = "#1f78b4",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = mean_lines,
    aes(
      x = Inf,
      y = Mean_Uncorrected,
      label = paste0("Mean Uncorrected = ", round(Mean_Uncorrected, 1), "%")
    ),
    hjust = 1,
    vjust = -0.3,
    color = "#e31a1c",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 3.5
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = mean_lines,
    aes(
      x = Inf,
      y = Mean_Corrected,
      label = paste0("Mean Corrected = ", round(Mean_Corrected, 1), "%")
    ),
    hjust = 1,
    vjust = -0.3,
    color = "#1f78b4",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 3.5
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c(
      "Uncorrected" = "#e31a1c",
      "Corrected"   = "#1f78b4"
    )
  ) +

  facet_grid(Change_Class ~ Polarity) +

  rt_x_scale +

  labs(
    x = "Retention Time (min)",
    y = "RSD (%)"
  ) +

  aligned_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )

plot_all

# ============================================================
# 7️⃣ Save plot
# ============================================================

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "Figure_SI-13.png"),
  plot = plot_all,
  width = 24,
  height = 18,
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 1000
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "Figure_SI-13.tiff"),
  plot = plot_all,
  width = 24,
  height = 18,
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 1000,
  device = "tiff",
  compression = "lzw"
)
```

## Figure SI-17. Resolution figure

```{r figure-si-17-setup}
#---------------------------------------------
# 1. Define mzML files + labels + starting scans
#---------------------------------------------
# Resolution mzML files live in a subfolder. Use a dedicated path variable so
# the global mzml_folder (used by every other figure) is NOT overwritten.
resolution_folder <- file.path(mzml_folder, "Resolution")

file_info <- data.frame(
  file = c(
    file.path(resolution_folder, "240925-Exp-PAN-1-010-NoWash-NIST.mzML"),
    file.path(resolution_folder, "240925-Exp-PAN-1-016-NoWash-NIST-R120.mzML"),
    file.path(resolution_folder, "240925-Exp-PAN-1-028-NoWash-NIST-R240.mzML")
  ),
  label = c("60K", "120K", "240K"),
  start_scan = c(333, 243, 157),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Ensure correct plotting order
file_info$label <- factor(file_info$label, levels = c("60K", "120K", "240K"))

#---------------------------------------------
# 2. Function to extract selected scans
#---------------------------------------------
process_file <- function(file_path, start_scan, label) {
  
  raw_data <- xcmsRaw(file_path)
  mz_range <- c(204.11, 204.13)
  
  # ⭐ Keep only 4 scans (remove 5th)
  scan_offsets <- c(0, 2, 4, 6)
  scans <- start_scan + scan_offsets
  
  spectra_list <- lapply(seq_along(scans), function(i) {
    
    scan_index <- scans[i]
    
    scan_start <- raw_data@scanindex[scan_index] + 1
    scan_end <- ifelse(scan_index + 1 <= length(raw_data@scanindex), 
                      raw_data@scanindex[scan_index + 1], 
                      length(raw_data@env$mz))
    
    mz_values <- raw_data@env$mz[scan_start:scan_end]
    intensity_values <- raw_data@env$intensity[scan_start:scan_end]
    
    df <- data.frame(mz = mz_values, intensity = intensity_values) %>%
      dplyr::filter(mz >= mz_range[1] & mz <= mz_range[2])
    
    # Handle empty spectra
    if (nrow(df) == 0) {
      df <- data.frame(
        mz = c(mz_range[1], mz_range[2]),
        intensity = c(0, 0)
      )
    }
    
    df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        sample = label,
        scan = factor(paste0("Scan ", i), levels = paste0("Scan ", 1:4))
      )
  })
  
  dplyr::bind_rows(spectra_list)
}

#---------------------------------------------
# 3. Process all files
#---------------------------------------------
combined_spectra <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
  list(file_info$file, file_info$start_scan, file_info$label),
  process_file
)

#---------------------------------------------
# 4. Plot
#---------------------------------------------
target_masses <- c(204.1173, 204.1230)

spectrum_glucose <- ggplot(combined_spectra, aes(x = mz, y = intensity)) +
  
  # ⭐ Color by resolution (sample)
  geom_line(aes(color = sample, group = interaction(sample, scan)), alpha = 0.7) +
  
  geom_vline(xintercept = target_masses, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  
  facet_grid(sample ~ scan, scales = "free_x") +
  
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 2.5e6)) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::scientific) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "Mass to Charge Ratio",
    breaks = target_masses,
    labels = format(target_masses, digits = 7)
  ) +
  
  # ⭐ Define clear colors for each resolution
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "60K"  = "#1f78b4",   # blue
      "120K" = "#33a02c",   # green
      "240K" = "#e31a1c"    # red
    )
  ) +
  
  labs(
    y = "Intensity",
    #title = "B"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none",   # keep off since faceted
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, face = "bold", size = 14)
  )

print(spectrum_glucose)

# Save
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "Figure_SI-17.png"),
  plot = spectrum_glucose,
  width = 20, height = 20, units = "cm", dpi = 1000
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "Figure_SI-17.tiff"),
  plot = spectrum_glucose,
  width = 20, height = 20, units = "cm",
  dpi = 1000, device = "tiff", compression = "lzw"
)
```

```{r figure-si-17-combining-dilution-and-me-plots-figure-7-and-8}
# ---- Combining dilution and ME plots (figure 7 and 8) ----

data5 <- dilution_data %>%

  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = str_remove(Sample, "\\.raw"),

    Wash = str_remove(Wash,"\\.raw"),
    Compound = replace(Compound, Compound == "#N/A", "TIC"),
    Compound = recode(Compound, !!!replacements),  # Apply replacements
    Sequence = as.numeric(Sequence),
    Dilution = as.factor(Dilution)
  ) %>%
  select(-Batch,-Exp) %>%
  arrange(Date) %>%
  filter(#Sample %in% c("Process", "NIST"),

  mutate(Replicate = row_number()) %>%
 ungroup() %>%
  select(1:5, Replicate, everything()) %>%
  mutate(Sample = ifelse(Wash == "NoFilter" & Sample == "Blank", "Reference", Sample)) %>%
   filter(Compound != "TIC")

combined_data <- data5 %>%

long_data_dilu <- combined_data %>%
  filter(Date == "241009",
         Compound %in% c(
           #"Indole-d6",
```
