```{r figure-si-17-combining-dilution-and-me-plots-figure-7-and-8}
# Define axis and zoom settings
x_limits <- c(0, 14)
zoom_limits <- c(0, 14)
vline_positions <- c(0.79, 2.2)

# Filter data
filtered_data_dilu <- long_data_dilu %>%
  filter(
    between(Times, x_limits[1], x_limits[2]),
    Compound == "Glucose-13C6",
    Wash == "NoWash",
    Sample != "Process"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Wash = factor(Wash, levels = c("22x", "08x", "NoWash", "PPT")))

# Summarise per scan/sample
summary_nowash_plot<- filtered_data_dilu %>%
  filter(Sample %in% c("NIST", "Solvent"), Date == "241009") %>%
  group_by(Compound, Scan, Wash, Sample, Dilution) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_time = mean(Times, na.rm = TRUE),
    NIST_n = sum(!is.na(Average[Sample == "NIST"])),
    NIST_mean = mean(Average[Sample == "NIST"], na.rm = TRUE),
    NIST_se = sd(Average[Sample == "NIST"], na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(NIST_n),
    Solvent_n = sum(!is.na(Average[Sample == "Solvent"])),
    Solvent_mean = mean(Average[Sample == "Solvent"], na.rm = TRUE),
    Solvent_se = sd(Average[Sample == "Solvent"], na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(Solvent_n),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Compound, Scan, Wash) %>%
  mutate(
    Solvent_mean = dplyr::first(Solvent_mean[Sample == "Solvent" & !is.na(Solvent_mean)]),
    Solvent_se = dplyr::first(Solvent_se[Sample == "Solvent" & !is.na(Solvent_se)]),
    Solvent_n = dplyr::first(Solvent_n[Sample == "Solvent" & !is.na(Solvent_n)])
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(Sample != "Solvent") %>%
  mutate(
    ME_NS_mean = ((NIST_mean / Solvent_mean) * 100) - 100,
    ME_NS_se = abs((NIST_mean / Solvent_mean) * 100) *
      sqrt((NIST_se / NIST_mean)^2 + (Solvent_se / Solvent_mean)^2),
    df = pmin(NIST_n, Solvent_n) - 1,
    t_val = qt(0.975, df = df),
    ME_NS_lower = ME_NS_mean - t_val * ME_NS_se,
    ME_NS_upper = ME_NS_mean + t_val * ME_NS_se,
    NIST_lower = NIST_mean - t_val * NIST_se,
    NIST_upper = NIST_mean + t_val * NIST_se,
    Solvent_lower = Solvent_mean - t_val * Solvent_se,
    Solvent_upper = Solvent_mean + t_val * Solvent_se
  )  %>%
  mutate(
    # Standard error of the difference
    se_diff = sqrt(NIST_se^2 + Solvent_se^2),

    # t-statistic for Welch's t-test
    t_stat = (NIST_mean - Solvent_mean) / se_diff,

    # Welch-Satterthwaite degrees of freedom
    df_welch = (NIST_se^2 + Solvent_se^2)^2 /
      ((NIST_se^4 / (NIST_n - 1)) + (Solvent_se^4 / (Solvent_n - 1))),

    # two-sided p-value
    p_value = 2 * pt(-abs(t_stat), df = df_welch)
  ) %>%
mutate(
    Dilution = recode(as.character(Dilution),
      "100" = "100%",
      "050" = "50%",
      "025" = "25%",
      "010" = "10%"
    ),
    Dilution = factor(Dilution, levels = c("100%", "50%", "25%", "10%"))
  )


# Plot B: Zoomed matrix effect + significance
plot_nowash_dilution <- summary_nowash_plot %>%
  filter(between(avg_time, zoom_limits[1], zoom_limits[2])) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = avg_time, y = ME_NS_mean, color = Dilution, fill = Dilution)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ME_NS_lower, ymax = ME_NS_upper), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_line(size = 0.8) +
  #geom_segment(data = sig_regions_ME, aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax, y = y, yend = y), color = "black", size = 0.8) +
  #geom_text(data = sig_regions_ME, aes(x = (xmin + xmax)/2, y = label_y, label = "*"), size = 6, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = vline_positions, linetype = "dotted", color = "black") +
  facet_grid(~Dilution ~Wash + Compound) +
  #coord_cartesian(ylim = c(global_min_y, global_max_y)) +
    labs( 
      title = bquote(atop("PLR unwashed plasma", "Glucose -"^{13}*"C"[6])),
   x = "Retention Time (min)",
  y = "Matrix Effect (%)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
 theme(
  legend.position = "none",
   strip.text = element_blank(),        
  #strip.text.y = element_blank(),
  #strip.text.x = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),      # ← keep axis line
  axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),      # ← keep ticks
   plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14) # center title
)
  

# Show final plot
```

## Figure SI-18. RSD change versus retention time

```{r figure-si-18-setup}
# ============================================================
# Validation RSD change across retention time
# Positive and negative mode stacked
# No empty Uncorrected facet
# Clean facet labels
# ============================================================

RSD_CUTOFF <- 5

type_levels <- c(
  "Best mean/uncorrected",
  "Best median/uncorrected",
  "Best min/uncorrected",
  "Best overall"
)

type_labels <- c(
  "Best mean/uncorrected"   = "Best mean",
  "Best median/uncorrected" = "Best median",
  "Best min/uncorrected"    = "Best minimum",
  "Best overall"            = "Best combination"
)

# ============================================================
# 1. Positive mode
# ============================================================

rsd_delta_rt_pos <- plot_df %>%
  filter(Type != "Uncorrected") %>%
  mutate(
    Delta_RSD = RSD_uncorrected - RSD_val
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    result_long %>%
      select(Feature, mean_rt) %>%
      group_by(Feature) %>%
      summarise(
        RT_min = mean(mean_rt, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = "Feature"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Category = case_when(
      Delta_RSD >  RSD_CUTOFF ~ "Improved",
      Delta_RSD < -RSD_CUTOFF ~ "Worsened",
      TRUE                    ~ "Less affected"
    ),
    Type = factor(Type, levels = type_levels)
  ) %>%
  droplevels()

outcome_counts_pos <- rsd_delta_rt_pos %>%
  count(Type, Category) %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    Type = factor(type_levels, levels = type_levels),
    Category = c("Improved", "Worsened", "Less affected"),
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Category,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    rsd_delta_rt_pos %>%
      count(Type, name = "Total_n"),
    by = "Type"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Total_n = replace_na(Total_n, 0),
    label = paste0(
      "\nImproved n = ", Improved,
      "\nWorsened n = ", Worsened
    )
  )

performance_table_pos <- rsd_delta_rt_pos %>%
  group_by(Type) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_n = n(),
    n_improved = sum(Delta_RSD > RSD_CUTOFF, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_worsened = sum(Delta_RSD < -RSD_CUTOFF, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_less_affected = sum(abs(Delta_RSD) <= RSD_CUTOFF, na.rm = TRUE),
    percent_improved = 100 * n_improved / Total_n,
    percent_worsened = 100 * n_worsened / Total_n,
    percent_less_affected = 100 * n_less_affected / Total_n,
    median_delta_RSD = median(Delta_RSD, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_delta_RSD = mean(Delta_RSD, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Polarity = "Positive ionization mode") %>%
  arrange(desc(percent_improved))

# ============================================================
# 2. Negative mode
# ============================================================

rsd_delta_rt_neg <- plot_df_neg %>%
  filter(Type != "Uncorrected") %>%
  mutate(
    Delta_RSD = RSD_uncorrected - RSD_val
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    result_long_neg %>%

        RT_min = mean(mean_rt, na.rm = TRUE),

  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Category = case_when(
      Delta_RSD >  RSD_CUTOFF ~ "Improved",
      Delta_RSD < -RSD_CUTOFF ~ "Worsened",
      TRUE                    ~ "Less affected"
    ),
    Type = factor(Type, levels = type_levels)
  ) %>%
  droplevels()

outcome_counts_neg <- rsd_delta_rt_neg %>%
  count(Type, Category) %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    Type = factor(type_levels, levels = type_levels),
    Category = c("Improved", "Worsened", "Less affected"),

  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Category,
    values_from = n,

  ) %>%

performance_table_neg <- rsd_delta_rt_neg %>%
  group_by(Type) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_n = n(),
    n_improved = sum(Delta_RSD > RSD_CUTOFF, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_worsened = sum(Delta_RSD < -RSD_CUTOFF, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_less_affected = sum(abs(Delta_RSD) <= RSD_CUTOFF, na.rm = TRUE),
    percent_improved = 100 * n_improved / Total_n,

    percent_less_affected = 100 * n_less_affected / Total_n,
    median_delta_RSD = median(Delta_RSD, na.rm = TRUE),

  ) %>%
  mutate(Polarity = "Negative ionization mode") %>%

# ============================================================

# ============================================================

outcome_counts_combined <- bind_rows(
  outcome_counts_pos %>% mutate(Polarity = "Positive ionization mode"),
  outcome_counts_neg %>% mutate(Polarity = "Negative ionization mode")
)

print(outcome_counts_combined)
```

## Figure SI-19. Isoleucine spike

```{r figure-si-19-setup}
# ===============================
# Settings
# ===============================

ppm <- 3
target_mz <- 138.1220  # IsoL-C13 [M+H]+

eic_cache_file <- here("Data", "eic_list2.rds")

# Set to TRUE only when you want to force re-extraction
force_reextract <- FALSE

# ===============================
# Function to extract EIC
# ===============================

extract_eic <- function(file_name, target_mz, ppm, polarity_label = "positive") {
  
  file_path <- file.path(mzml_folder, file_name)
  
  raw_data <- xcmsRaw(file_path)
  
  mz_tol <- (ppm / 1e6) * target_mz
  mz_range <- c(target_mz - mz_tol, target_mz + mz_tol)
  
  positive_scans <- which(raw_data@polarity == polarity_label)
  
  eic <- rawEIC(raw_data, mzrange = mz_range)
  
  eic_df <- data.frame(
    rt = raw_data@scantime[positive_scans] / 60,
    intensity = eic$intensity[positive_scans],
    scan = seq_along(positive_scans),
    target = paste0("m/z ", round(target_mz, 4)),
    file_name = rep(file_name, length(positive_scans))
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      average_intensity = zoo::rollmean(
        intensity,
        k = 5,
        fill = NA,
        align = "left"
      )
    )
  
  return(eic_df)
}

# ===============================
# List of mzML files
# ===============================

files <- c(
  "241008-Exp-PAN-1-035-NoWash-NIST.mzML",
  "241008-Exp-PAN-1-036-NoWash-NIST.mzML",
  "241008-Exp-PAN-1-037-NoWash-NIST.mzML",
  "241008-Exp-PAN-1-014-22x-NIST.mzML",
  "241008-Exp-PAN-1-015-22x-NIST.mzML",
  "241008-Exp-PAN-1-016-22x-NIST.mzML",
  "241008-Exp-PAN-1-028-04x-NIST.mzML",
  "241008-Exp-PAN-1-029-04x-NIST.mzML",
  "241008-Exp-PAN-1-030-04x-NIST.mzML",
  "241008-Exp-PAN-1-021-08x-NIST.mzML",
  "241008-Exp-PAN-1-022-08x-NIST.mzML",
  "241008-Exp-PAN-1-023-08x-NIST.mzML",
  "241008-Exp-PAN-1-042-PPT-NIST.mzML",
  "241008-Exp-PAN-1-043-PPT-NIST.mzML",
  "241008-Exp-PAN-1-044-PPT-NIST.mzML"
)

# ===============================
# Extract EICs only if not already saved
# ===============================

dir.create(
  dirname(eic_cache_file),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

if (file.exists(eic_cache_file) && !force_reextract) {
  
  message("Loading saved EIC data from: ", eic_cache_file)
  eic_list2 <- readRDS(eic_cache_file)
  
} else {
  
  message("No saved EIC data found, or force_reextract = TRUE. Extracting EICs...")
  
  eic_list2 <- lapply(files, function(file_name) {
    extract_eic(file_name, target_mz, ppm)
  })
  
  saveRDS(
    eic_list2,
    file = eic_cache_file
  )
  
  message("Saved EIC data to: ", eic_cache_file)
}

# ===============================
# Combine all EICs
# ===============================

combined_eic_df <- bind_rows(eic_list2)

# ===============================
# Filter and parse file names
# ===============================

combined_eic_df_filtered <- combined_eic_df %>%
  filter(rt >= 2 & rt <= 4) %>%
  separate(
    file_name,
    into = c(
      "Date",
      "Exp",
      "PAN",
      "Batch",
      "Sequence",
      "Wash",
      "Sample"
    ),
    sep = "-",
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = str_remove(Sample, "\\.mzML"),
    Sequence = as.numeric(Sequence),
    Wash = factor(
      Wash,
      levels = c("22x", "08x", "04x", "NoWash", "PPT")
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-Exp, -Batch) %>%
  arrange(Date) %>%
  group_by(Wash, Sample) %>%
  mutate(
    Replicate = dense_rank(Sequence)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

print(combined_eic_df_filtered)

# ===============================
# Plot extracted EICs
# ===============================

combined_eic_plot <- combined_eic_df_filtered %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = rt, y = intensity, color = Wash)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~Wash + Replicate, ncol = 3) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Overlayed EICs (", ppm, "ppm, Positive Mode)"),
    x = "Retention Time (min)",
    y = "Intensity",
    color = "Wash"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(combined_eic_plot)

# ===============================
# Filter long_data
# ===============================

filtered_data_2 <- long_data %>%
  filter(
    Sequence %in% 1:45,
    Compound %in% c(
      "Glucose-13C6",
      "Leucine-d10",
      "Tryptophan-d5",
      "Indole-d6",
      "StearicAcid-d35",
      "Carnitine-d9"
    ),
    Wash %in% c("22x", "08x", "04x", "NoWash", "PPT"),
    !(Replicate %in% c("1", "2", "3", "4", "6") & Sample == "Solvent"),
    Replicate %in% 1:8
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Wash = factor(
      Wash,
      levels = c("22x", "08x", "04x", "NoWash", "PPT")
    )
  )

# ===============================
# Calculate Matrix Effect Factor
# ===============================

matrix_effect_data <- filtered_data_2 %>%
  filter(Sample %in% c("NIST", "Solvent")) %>%
  group_by(Sequence, Wash, Scan, Compound, Sample, Replicate) %>%
  summarise(
    Average_value = mean(Intensities, na.rm = TRUE),
    Times = dplyr::first(Times),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Sample,
    values_from = Average_value
  ) %>%
  group_by(Wash, Scan, Compound) %>%
  summarise(
    Solvent_mean = mean(Solvent, na.rm = TRUE),
    NIST_value = NIST[!is.na(NIST)],
    Times = dplyr::first(Times),
    Replicate = Replicate[!is.na(NIST)],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Matrix_Effect = ((NIST_value / Solvent_mean) * 100) - 100,
    Matrix_Effect_Factor = 1 + (Matrix_Effect / 100)
  )

# ===============================
# Plot Matrix Effect Factor over time
# ===============================

matrix_effect_factor_time_plot <- ggplot(
  matrix_effect_data,
  aes(x = Times, y = Matrix_Effect_Factor, color = Wash)
) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 4.84,
    linetype = "dotted",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 1.00,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    Wash + Replicate ~ Compound
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Matrix Effect Factor (MEF) over Time for NIST Replicates",
    x = "Time (minutes)",
    y = "Matrix Effect Factor",
    color = "Wash Condition"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top"
  )

print(matrix_effect_factor_time_plot)
```

### Plots

```{r figure-si-19-plots}
# Step 1: Filter for the closest `rt` to 4.84 within each group (Wash and Replicate)
combined_eic_df_filtered2 <- combined_eic_df_filtered %>%
  group_by(Wash, Replicate) %>%  
 #filter(rt == rt[which.min(abs(rt - 4.85))]) %>%
  filter(rt == rt[which.max(intensity)]) %>%
  ungroup()  # Remove grouping after filtering

# Step 2: Find the closest `rt`, `Times`, and `Scan` in `matrix_effect_data` for each `rt`
combined_eic_df_filtered2 <- combined_eic_df_filtered2 %>%
  mutate(
    #closest_rt = purrr::map_dbl(rt, ~matrix_effect_data$Times[which.min(abs(matrix_effect_data$Times - .))]),
    closest_time = purrr::map_dbl(rt, ~matrix_effect_data$Times[which.min(abs(matrix_effect_data$Times - .))]),
    closest_scan = purrr::map_dbl(closest_time, ~matrix_effect_data$Scan[which.min(abs(matrix_effect_data$Times - .))]),
    scan_diff = scan - closest_scan  # Calculate the difference of the scans
  ) %>%
  ungroup()  # Remove grouping after mutation

# Step 3: Apply `scan_diff` to the original data and adjust the scan
combined_eic_df_with_shift <- combined_eic_df_filtered %>%
  left_join(
    combined_eic_df_filtered2 %>% select(Wash, Replicate, scan_diff),
    by = c("Wash", "Replicate")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    adjusted_scan = scan - scan_diff  # Apply the scan shift to get the adjusted scan
  )

# Step 4: Join `Matrix_Effect_Factor` (MEF) based on `adjusted_scan`
# -----------------------------
combined_eic_df_with_shift <- combined_eic_df_with_shift %>%
  left_join(
    matrix_effect_data %>%
      select(Wash, Replicate, Scan, Matrix_Effect_Factor, Compound),
    by = c("Wash", "Replicate", "adjusted_scan" = "Scan")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    corrected_intensity = intensity / Matrix_Effect_Factor,
    
    # Wash factor + labels
    Wash = factor(Wash, levels = c("22x", "08x", "04x", "NoWash", "PPT")),
    Wash = recode(
      Wash,
      "22x"    = "PLR 22x wash",
      "08x"    = "PLR 8x wash",
      "04x"    = "PLR 4x wash",
      "NoWash" = "PLR unwashed",
      "PPT"    = "PPT"
    ),
    
    # Compound labels for plotting (parsed)
    Compound_plot = recode(
      Compound,
      "Average"        = "Average",
      "Tryptophan-d5"  = "Tryptophan-d[5]",
      "Leucine-d10"    = "Leucine-d[10]",
      "Glucose-13C6"   = "Glucose-{}^{13}*C[6]"
    ,
    "StearicAcid-d35" = "Stearic~acid-d[35]",
    "Indole-d6" = "Indole-d[6]",
    "Carnitine-d9" = "Carnitine-d[9]")
  )

# -----------------------------
# Define explicit facet order
# -----------------------------
compound_plot_levels <- c(
  "Tryptophan-d[5]",
  "Leucine-d[10]",
  "Glucose-{}^{13}*C[6]", "Stearic~acid-d[35]",
"Indole-d[6]",
"Carnitine-d[9]")

# -----------------------------
# Step 5: Pivot to long format
# -----------------------------
combined_eic_df_filtered_long <- combined_eic_df_with_shift %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(intensity, corrected_intensity),
    names_to = "Intensity_Type",
    values_to = "Intensity_Value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Wash, rt, Matrix_Effect_Factor, Sample, Replicate,
    Intensity_Type, Sequence, Compound, Compound_plot
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Average_Intensity = mean(Intensity_Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Compound_plot = factor(
      Compound_plot,
      levels = compound_plot_levels
    )
  )

# -----------------------------

# -----------------------------

  max(combined_eic_df_filtered_long$Matrix_Effect_Factor, na.rm = TRUE)

  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +

    # axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),

    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_blank(),

    ) +
```

### Barplot

```{r figure-si-19-barplot}
# ===============================
# Step 1: Trapezoidal integration
# ===============================
integrated_data <- combined_eic_df_filtered_long %>% 
  filter(
    !is.na(rt),
    !is.na(Average_Intensity),
    !is.na(Compound)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Wash, Sample, Replicate, Intensity_Type, Sequence, Compound) %>%
  summarise(
    integration_area = trapz(rt, Average_Intensity),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ===============================
# Step 2: Wide format
# ===============================
integrated_data_wide <- integrated_data %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = Intensity_Type,
    values_from = integration_area
  )

# ===============================
# Step 3: Back to long
# ===============================
integrated_data_long_wide <- integrated_data_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Wash, Sample, Replicate, Sequence, Compound),
    names_to = "Intensity_Type",
    values_to = "integration_area"
  )

# ===============================
# Step 4: Filter + relabel
# ===============================
integrated_data_long_wide_filtered <- integrated_data_long_wide %>%
  group_by(Wash, Replicate) %>%
  filter(!(Intensity_Type == "intensity" & duplicated(Intensity_Type))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Compound = if_else(
      Intensity_Type == "intensity",
      "Uncorrected",
      Compound
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Intensity_Type != "intensity" | Compound == "Uncorrected"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Compound = factor(
      Compound,
      levels = c(
        "Uncorrected",
        "Tryptophan-d5",
        "Leucine-d10",
        "Glucose-13C6",
        "StearicAcid-d35",
        "Indole-d6",
        "Carnitine-d9"
      )
    )
  )

# ===============================
# Step 5: Error statistics
# ===============================
error_data <- integrated_data_long_wide_filtered %>%
  group_by(Wash, Compound) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(integration_area, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD   = sd(integration_area, na.rm = TRUE),
    SE   = SD / sqrt(n()),
    RSD_percent = (SD / Mean) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ===============================
# Step 6: Compound labels
# ===============================
error_data <- error_data %>%
  mutate(
    Compound_plot = recode(
      as.character(Compound),
      "Uncorrected"     = "Uncorrected",
      "Tryptophan-d5"   = "Tryptophan-d[5]",
      "Leucine-d10"     = "Leucine-d[10]",
      "Glucose-13C6"    = "Glucose-{}^{13}*C[6]",
      "StearicAcid-d35" = "Stearic~acid-d[35]",
      "Indole-d6"       = "Indole-d[6]",
      "Carnitine-d9"    = "Carnitine-d[9]"
    ),
    Compound_plot = factor(
      Compound_plot,
      levels = c(
        "Uncorrected",
        "Tryptophan-d[5]",
        "Leucine-d[10]",
        "Glucose-{}^{13}*C[6]",
        "Stearic~acid-d[35]",
        "Indole-d[6]",
        "Carnitine-d[9]"
      )
    )
  )

compound_rsd_all_washes <- integrated_data_long_wide_filtered %>%
  group_by(Compound) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_all = mean(integration_area, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_all = sd(integration_area, na.rm = TRUE),
    RSD_all_washes = (SD_all / Mean_all) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Compound_plot = recode(
      as.character(Compound),
      "Uncorrected"     = "Uncorrected",
      "Tryptophan-d5"   = "Tryptophan-d[5]",
      "Leucine-d10"     = "Leucine-d[10]",
      "Glucose-13C6"    = "Glucose-{}^{13}*C[6]",
      "StearicAcid-d35" = "Stearic~acid-d[35]",
      "Indole-d6"       = "Indole-d[6]",
      "Carnitine-d9"    = "Carnitine-d[9]"
    ),
    Compound_plot = factor(
      Compound_plot,
      levels = levels(error_data$Compound_plot)
    )
  )

# ===============================
# Step 7: Bar plot
# ===============================
barplot_compounds_with_error_leu <- ggplot(
  error_data,
  aes(x = Wash, y = Mean, fill = Wash)
) +
  geom_bar(
    stat = "identity",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = Mean - SE, ymax = Mean + SE),
    width = 0.25,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      y = Mean + SE + 0.05,
      label = paste0(signif(RSD_percent, 2), "%")
    ),
    size = 3,
    vjust = -0.5
  ) +
  geom_text(
  data = compound_rsd_all_washes,
  aes(
    x = 3,
    y = Inf,
    label = paste0("RSD = ", round(RSD_all_washes, 1), "%")
  ),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  vjust = 1.3,
  #fontface = "bold",
  size = 2.5
) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::scientific,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.3))
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~Compound_plot,
    ncol = 7,
    drop = TRUE,
    labeller = labeller(Compound_plot = label_parsed)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "B",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Integrated Area",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "black"),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0,
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    )
  )

# ===============================
# Display
# ===============================
print(barplot_compounds_with_error_leu)

### Combine Plots:

combined_mef_plot_leu <- All_plot_EIC_long_leu / barplot_compounds_with_error_leu 
 
print(combined_mef_plot_leu)
```

## Table SI-4

```{r table-si-4-setup}
#---------------------------------------------
# 1. Filter and recode wash labels
#---------------------------------------------
wash_subset <- summarized_data %>%
  filter(homologue_id %in% c(1,14,16,17,18,19),
         Sequence <= 45,
         Sample == "Blank",
         Wash %in% c("NoWash", "22x", "08x", "04x")) %>%
  mutate(
    Wash = recode(Wash,
                  "22x"    = "PLR 22x Wash",
                  "08x"    = "PLR 8x Wash",
                  "04x"    = "PLR 4x Wash",
                  "NoWash" = "PLR Unwashed"),
    Wash = factor(Wash,
                  levels = c("PLR Unwashed", "PLR 4x Wash",
                             "PLR 8x Wash", "PLR 22x Wash")),
    
    # ⭐ New readable facet labels
    homologue_id = factor(homologue_id,
                          levels = c(1,14,16,17,18,19),
                          labels = c("1",
                                     "14",
                                     "16",
                                     "17",
                                     "18",
                                     "19"))
  )

#---------------------------------------------
# Mean summary table
#---------------------------------------------
wash_means_pub <- wash_subset %>%
  group_by(homologue_id, Wash) %>%
  summarise(
    n    = n(),
    Mean = round(mean(Intensity, na.rm = TRUE), 0),   # no decimals
    SD   = round(sd(Intensity, na.rm = TRUE), 0),     # no decimals
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(homologue_id, Wash)

kable(
  wash_means_pub,
  caption = "Table SI-4. Summary statistics of treatment-derived contaminant intensities across PLR wash conditions. Values are reported as mean ± standard deviation for each homologue series ID, calculated from blank samples for PLR Unwashed, PLR 4× Wash, PLR 8× Wash, and PLR 22× Wash conditions.",
  col.names = c("Homologue ID", "Wash Condition", "Sample Count (n)", "Mean Intensity", "SD Intensity"),
  align = "c",
  booktabs = TRUE,
  format = "html"   # ensures nice formatting when copied to Word
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center",
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed")
  ) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%                 # bold header
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "middle")  # group homologues


```
